implementerProof.how: I re-ran the slow-page, broker recovery, migration, upload-lock, pointer, revoke and token tests and the two-build harness against legion-envoy-v27.2.1 at 0e545db0. They pass locally, but CI at the same head fails the slow-page test (failure 1).

failures.criterion: (7) ci-ok at the code head; (1) the slow-page revoke test is reliable.
failures.evidence: CI run 41361396521 at 0e545db0: envoy-go (job 125014853163) and envoy-go-race-docs (job 125014853168) both FAIL TestARevokedSlowPageEndsOnACodeItReconnectsOnAndSyncsWhole at schema_admission_test.go:572: 'the revoked page, reading two seconds after the revoke ended with read tcp ...: i/o timeout, want a close with 4412 or the 1006 ...' (35.29s and 50.99s). The server-side check at line 560 passed, so ServeHTTP returned within 2.5 s of the revoke; the page then read for its whole 30 s drain deadline and got neither a close nor EOF. ygo's cancel path closes the connection (closeConn, then ws.Close on return; provider/websocket/server.go around line 2145), so that is not the receive-window pace the test assumes. Not reproduced locally in 100 runs: 30 plain with -cpu=1,2, 10 -race, 10 with every CPU saturated, 30 plain and 20 beside whole-package load. Read the failure with: gh api repos/sjawhar/legion/actions/jobs/125014853163/logs --allow-escape-sequences | grep -a -A2 'FAIL: TestARevokedSlowPage'. This is not one of the flakes the architect allowed (TestEditNoticeRestart, overlapping-marks.e2e.ts:311, runner disk). The failing test is itself the red test.
